abilities.name: Beast Companion
abilities.description: You gain a follower that is a level 2 beast of your size or smaller that accompanies you and follows your instructions. You and your GM must work out the appearance and personality of your beast. Its movement is based on its creature type (avian, swimmer, and so on).

abilities.name: Friend to Small Creatures
abilities.description: A type of small creature you name that exists in the surrounding environment (such as insects, rats, bats, or birds) comes under your influence if you succeed on a difficulty 2 Intellect task for outdoor survival. Affected creatures within short range will not harm you or those you designate as allies until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery.

abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: Your creatures collectively respond to your commands as an NPC ally.

system.description:
A Dungeon Fantasy Type focused on druid archetypal play, with clear room for a character's own story and abilities.

Genre: Fantasy. Subgenre: Dungeon Fantasy. Primary Pools: might, intellect.
